description: Graph mail + SharePoint adapter probe through the GET-only client: token, one message and the drive root, citation round-trips; counts and shapes only.
notes: registry_names: the source registry credits a Graph endpoint template only through operations_read, the grammar operations (integrations/live_source_grammar.py) this run's GETs were answered for; an endpoint no operation folds to is never credited by this check. Blocked: a read Graph answers 403 with its permission-refusal code (Authorization_RequestDenied or ErrorAccessDenied, integrations.graph_read.probe_block) is a top-level blocked_upstream part in capture_mail.graph_block's shape (error_code missing_permission, cause host_misconfiguration, the application permission it needs); expect_blocked then applies and the check reads blocked, never pass. Any other failure (401, a 403 with another code or none, 5xx, transport, a malformed answer) still fails. The refused parts: the users listing (mail.user_listing, User.Read.All; the probe then has no first-user mailbox) or the mailbox's lookup or message read (mail.mailbox_lookup User.Read.All, mail.folder_read Mail.Read); the command exits 1 (ok false) and the site and SharePoint parts must still meet expect, so a blocked run is measured in part (site.drives_count >= 1) and a SharePoint failure beside the refusal still fails. Expected while consent graph-mail-directory-consent is outstanding (live 2026-10-19: /users 403 authorization_request_denied): blocked_upstream [{part mail.user_listing, http_status 403, error_code missing_permission, permission User.Read.All}]. People guard: with PLX_EXCLUDED_PEOPLE_OIDS unset or invalid the guard refuses the mailbox before any per-mailbox request (fail closed) and the probe reports a top-level blocked_upstream part {part mail.people_exclusion, source people-exclusion, http_status null, error_code the guard's code, cause later_ask, later_ask excluded-people-oids}; a refused directory listing that would bind it stays the 403 mail.user_listing part above, and any other unresolved guard (a 5xx or truncated listing) fails. expect_blocked applies the same way: the check reads blocked naming later_ask, with SharePoint measured in the same run.
